norms.note: No cutoffs, diagnostic bands, Chinese percentiles or school norms are supported by the reviewed official pages. Do not use response-range thirds as empirical thresholds.

nameZh: IPIP他人痛苦情绪反应10题（研究译稿）
attribution: Barchard (2001), as attributed by the official IPIP key; do not claim a complete emotional-intelligence battery.

items.en: Am deeply moved by others' misfortunes.
items.zh: 别人的不幸会深深触动我。
我很容易被触动而流泪。
别人的悲伤也会让我感到痛苦。

items.en: Am upset by the misfortunes of strangers.
items.zh: 陌生人的不幸也会让我难过。

items.en: Would be upset if I saw an injured animal.
items.zh: 如果看到受伤的动物，我会难过。

items.en: Am calm even in tense situations.
items.zh: 即使在紧张的情境中，我也很平静。

items.en: Am not easily disturbed by events.
items.zh: 发生的事情不容易使我心烦意乱。

items.en: Am unaffected by the suffering of others.
items.zh: 别人的痛苦不会影响我的情绪。
看悲伤的电影时，我很少哭。
遇到紧急情况时，我保持平静。

reliability.interpretation: Official English-source group coefficients, women N=432 and men N=317; not evidence of Chinese reliability, individual accuracy or normative thresholds.
reliability.caution: English source alpha .59/.63 is limited internal consistency; exploration only, never individual high-stakes decisions or Chinese validity claim.

construct: Self-reported distress resonance and emotional reactivity to others suffering and tense situations; not total empathy, compassion, helpful behavior, trauma, or objective crisis-response skill.

feedback.summary: 这份回答像一张情绪观察便签：当你看到别人难过、动物受伤，或遇到紧张场面时，自己的心情会怎样跟着变化？
feedback.direction: 计分方向越高，表示自己的情绪更容易被这些场景触动；保持平静不代表冷漠，容易难过也不自动代表更善良或更会帮助别人。
feedback.reflection: 回想一次别人向你诉苦：你既听到了对方的需要，也留意到自己的感受了吗？你的反应是否让你更能陪伴对方？
feedback.action: 下次听到难过的事情，可以先问一句“你希望我陪你听一听，还是一起想办法？”如果自己也被情绪淹没，允许短暂休息，再决定能提供什么帮助。
feedback.limits: 来源英文研究中，这组题回答的一致程度有限，因此更适合谨慎探索，不适合据此给个人贴标签或做重要决定。中文译稿尚待审核与验证，没有项目常模或诊断分界值。

population: 成人研究使用边界；非中文效度声明

versionNote: Current official 10-item key accessed 2026-10-25; retain exact item wording and official keys.
family: IPIP scales measuring seven components potentially related to emotional intelligence (Barchard, 2001); this isolated component is not a full emotional-intelligence test and is not another proprietary instrument.

deduplication.note: Also grep-checked repository keys and distinguishing first items; no matching instrument. Shared IPIP items do not mean duplicate complete scales.
